create_FlashAttentionBackend: create a FlashAttentionBackend instance for serving LLM models with flash attention inference
init_FlashAttentionBackend_forward_metad: initialize forward metadata for a FlashAttentionBackend given a ForwardBatch with sequence lengths and page tables
run_FlashAttentionBackend_forward_extend: run the forward_extend method on FlashAttentionBackend to compute multi-head attention during prefill
run_FlashAttentionBackend_forward_decode: run the forward_decode method on FlashAttentionBackend to compute single-token self-attention during decode
build_normal_decode_set_metadata: build a fused Triton metadata computation for normal decode replacing multiple sequential CUDA kernels with one kernel
